pages.text: The walls, floor and ceiling of every $(l)treasure room$() are made of $(item)Warded Masonry$(): glowing runes, unbreakable and impossible to dig around. When the dungeon boss dies, the runes fade and the masonry turns back into ordinary bricks: no more shortcuts!$(br2)Dungeons also hide $(l)Mimics$() among their chests, including on the citadel balconies.
pages.title: Salles scellées
